question: Wane ne misalin gajeriyar wasula a cikin harshen Hausa?
explanation: Wasula gajeru a Hausa sun hada da a, e, i, o, u wadanda ba a ninka su ba.
subtopic: Wasula (Wasula Masu Gajerun Sauti Da Wasula Masu Dogayen Sauti)

question: Wasulan Hausa na asali nawa ne gaba daya?
explanation: Hausa tana da wasula gajeru 5 da kuma dogayen wasula 5, wanda ya zama 10 baki daya.
subtopic: Wasula (Wasula Masu Gajerun Sauti Da Wasula Masu Dogayen Sauti)

question: Wane harafi ne ke wakiltar doguwar wasula ta 'i'?
explanation: Doguwar wasula ta 'i' ana rubuta ta ne a matsayin 'ii' don nuna tsawon sautinta.
subtopic: Wasula (Wasula Masu Gajerun Sauti Da Wasula Masu Dogayen Sauti)

question: Wanne daga cikin wadannan kalmomi ke dauke da gajeriyar wasula?
explanation: Kalmar 'fà' tana dauke da gajeriyar wasula ta 'a' dayatil.
subtopic: Wasula (Wasula Masu Gajerun Sauti Da Wasula Masu Dogayen Sauti)

question: Wanne ne misalin doguwar wasula ta 'u'?
explanation: Doguwar wasula ta 'u' ana nuna ta ne ta hanyar rubuta 'uu'.
subtopic: Wasula (Wasula Masu Gajerun Sauti Da Wasula Masu Dogayen Sauti)

question: Ta yaya ake bambanta gajerun wasula da dogayen wasula a rubuce?
explanation: Dogayen wasula a Hausa ana nuna su ne ta wajen ninka harafin wasular.
subtopic: Wasula (Wasula Masu Gajerun Sauti Da Wasula Masu Dogayen Sauti)

question: Wane abu ne doguwar wasula ke yi a cikin kalma?
explanation: Canza gajeriyar wasula zuwa doguwa kan iya canza ma'anar kalma gaba daya.
subtopic: Wasula (Wasula Masu Gajerun Sauti Da Wasula Masu Dogayen Sauti)

question: Wanne daga cikin wadannan rukunai ne na dogayen wasula?
explanation: Rukunin dogayen wasula a Hausa sune aa, ee, ii, oo, da uu.
subtopic: Wasula (Wasula Masu Gajerun Sauti Da Wasula Masu Dogayen Sauti)

question: Mene ne bambanci tsakanin 'fada' da 'faada'?
explanation: Bambancin yana cikin amfani da gajeriyar wasula a 'fada' da kuma doguwar wasula a 'faada'.
subtopic: Wasula (Wasula Masu Gajerun Sauti Da Wasula Masu Dogayen Sauti)

question: Wacce wasula ce ke biye da 'o' a cikin dogayen wasula?
explanation: Doguwar wasula ta 'o' ita ce 'oo'.
subtopic: Wasula (Wasula Masu Gajerun Sauti Da Wasula Masu Dogayen Sauti)

question: Wane bakake ne ake furta su ta hanyar haɗa leɓuna biyu?
explanation: Bakaken leɓe (bilabials) sune waɗanda ake furta su ta hanyar haɗa leɓuna biyu wuri guda kamar b, m, da f.
subtopic: Bakake (Rabe-raben Bakaken Hausa da wuraren furta su)

question: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan ba bakin leɓe ba ne?
explanation: Harafin 't' ba baƙin leɓe ba ne, shi baƙin hakora ne ko gumaka domin ana furta shi ne da taimakon harshe da hakora.
subtopic: Bakake (Rabe-raben Bakaken Hausa da wuraren furta su)

question: Wane baƙi ne wurin furtarsa ke zama a bayan hakora?
explanation: Ana kiran bakaken da ake amfani da harshe wajen taɓa bayan hakora da bakaken hakora kamar t da d.
subtopic: Bakake (Rabe-raben Bakaken Hausa da wuraren furta su)

question: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan baƙaƙe ne ake furta su da maƙogwaro?
explanation: Bakaken maƙogwaro sune waɗanda ake fitar da sautinsu daga cikin maƙogwaro kamar h.
subtopic: Bakake (Rabe-raben Bakaken Hausa da wuraren furta su)

question: Ta yaya ake furta baƙin 'm' a Hausa?
explanation: Harafin 'm' baƙi ne na leɓe wanda kuma ana furta shi ta hanyar barin iska ta fita ta hanci (nasal).
subtopic: Bakake (Rabe-raben Bakaken Hausa da wuraren furta su)

question: Wane wuri ake furta baƙin 'sh' da shi a baki?
explanation: Ana furta baƙin 'sh' ne lokacin da tsakiyar harshe ya matse da saman baki (bayan gumaka).
subtopic: Bakake (Rabe-raben Bakaken Hausa da wuraren furta su)

question: Wanne ne cikakken baƙin harshe da gindi?
explanation: Ana furta baƙin 'k' da 'g' ne ta hanyar haɗa bayan harshe da sashin da ke bayan saman baki (velars).
subtopic: Bakake (Rabe-raben Bakaken Hausa da wuraren furta su)

question: Menene sunan bakaken da ake furta su ta hanyar taɓa bango na biyu na saman baki?
explanation: Bakaken da ake furta su a yankin sararin baki na sama ana kiran su palatals kamar 'y' da 'sh'.
subtopic: Bakake (Rabe-raben Bakaken Hausa da wuraren furta su)

question: Tsarin saki da kulle iska yana faruwa ne a:
explanation: Wuraren furta sauti a cikin baki da maƙogwaro sune ke sarrafa yadda iska ke fita ko ta kulle.
subtopic: Bakake (Rabe-raben Bakaken Hausa da wuraren furta su)

question: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan baƙaƙe ne masu fitar da sautin hanci?
explanation: Bakaken hanci (nasals) a cikin Hausa sun haɗa da 'n' da 'm' saboda iska na fita ta hanci yayin furta su.
subtopic: Bakake (Rabe-raben Bakaken Hausa da wuraren furta su)

question: Wane ne misalin gajarta sautin (elision) a cikin Hausa?
explanation: A 'gidan sarki' ana iya samun raguwar sauti wajen saurin magana kamar 'gid' sarki'.
subtopic: Hada-hadasar Sauti (Assimilation, Elision da Sauransu)

question: Mene ne ake nufi da hade-hadasar sauti?
explanation: Hade-hadasar sauti shine yadda sauti ke canzawa saboda tasirin wani sautin dake kusa da shi.
subtopic: Hada-hadasar Sauti (Assimilation, Elision da Sauransu)

question: Wanne ne ke nuna canjin sauti ta fuskar baki?
explanation: Assimilation (hada-hada) na faruwa ne idan sauti daya ya yi kama da wani.
subtopic: Hada-hadasar Sauti (Assimilation, Elision da Sauransu)

question: Idan 'goro' da 'dan' suka nade suka zama 'goron dan', wane tsari ne?
explanation: An samu canji a wajen haɗin don sauƙaƙe furci.
subtopic: Hada-hadasar Sauti (Assimilation, Elision da Sauransu)

question: Wanne daga cikin wadannan ke nuna faduwar harafi (elision)?
explanation: Faduwar 'a' ko 'e' a ciki yana haifar da gajarta kalma ta hanyar elision.
subtopic: Hada-hadasar Sauti (Assimilation, Elision da Sauransu)

question: Me ke faruwa lokacin da sautuna biyu suka zama iri daya sakamakon kusanci?
explanation: Wannan shine cikakkiyar hada-hadasar sauti (complete assimilation).
subtopic: Hada-hadasar Sauti (Assimilation, Elision da Sauransu)

question: Wanne ne ke haifar da raguwar harafi a baki?
explanation: Elision shine zubar da wani sauti saboda saurin magana.
subtopic: Hada-hadasar Sauti (Assimilation, Elision da Sauransu)

question: Tsarin da ke sa sautin baki ya bi na gaba ana kiran sa da:
explanation: Regressive assimilation na nufin sautin baya yana rinjayear na gaba.
subtopic: Hada-hadasar Sauti (Assimilation, Elision da Sauransu)

question: A cikin Hausa, sau da yawa me ke faruwa ga wasali na karshe a lokacin saurin magana?
explanation: Wasalin karshe kan fadi ta hanyar elision don saukin furci.
subtopic: Hada-hadasar Sauti (Assimilation, Elision da Sauransu)

question: Wanne ne misali mafi sauki na hada-hadasar sauti a Hausa?
explanation: A maganar yau da kullum, 'Ina zuwa' kan canza zuwa 'In'zuwa'.
subtopic: Hada-hadasar Sauti (Assimilation, Elision da Sauransu)

question: Wane gabobin magana ne ke matsewa domin tsayar da iska wajen fitar da sautin /b/?
explanation: Sautin /b/ na buƙatar rufe laɓɓa biyu baki ɗaya sannan a sake su tare da fashewa.
subtopic: Gabobin Magana Da Muhimmancin Su

question: Mene ne babban muhimmancin gabobin magana a tsarin sautin Hausa?
explanation: Gabobin magana suna aiki ne wajen canza iskar da ke fita daga huhu ta zama sautuka daban-daban.
subtopic: Gabobin Magana Da Muhimmancin Su

question: Wanne sashi na harshe ke fitar da sautukan gaba kamar /i/ da /e/?
explanation: Gaban harshe ne ke tashi sama da gaba wajen furta sautuka marasa duhu kamar /i/ da /e/.
subtopic: Gabobin Magana Da Muhimmancin Su

question: A wane wuri ne ake furta sautin /k/ ta hanyar taɓa harshe da lafazin baya?
explanation: Sautin /k/ na dogara ne ga bayan harshe yana taɓa tausasaben baka wajen fitowa.
subtopic: Gabobin Magana Da Muhimmancin Su

question: Wane gabobin magana ne ke aiki tare wajen samar da sautin /f/?
explanation: Ana furta /f/ ne ta hanyar mannewar leɓen sama da haƙoran ƙasa don tace iska.
subtopic: Gabobin Magana Da Muhimmancin Su

question: Mene ne rawar da hanci yake takawa a cikin gabobin magana?
explanation: Hanci na ba da damar fitar da iska ta hanci idan ana furta sautukan hanci kamar /m/ da /n/.
subtopic: Gabobin Magana Da Muhimmancin Su

question: Wane gabobin magana ne aka fi kira da 'laɓɓa' a tsarin sauti?
explanation: Laɓɓa sun ƙunshi leɓen sama da leɓen ƙasa waɗanda ke haɗuwa don fitar da sautukan labial.
subtopic: Gabobin Magana Da Muhimmancin Su

question: Ta yaya makogwaro ke taimakawa wajen rarrabe sautuka?

options.D: Ta fitar da yawu mai yawa

explanation: Maƙogwaro ya ƙunshi igiyoyin murya waɗanda ke rawa don samar da muryar sautuka.
subtopic: Gabobin Magana Da Muhimmancin Su

question: Wane wuri ne harshe ke taɓawa wajen furta sautin /t/ a Hausa?
explanation: Sautin /t/ na buƙatar tsayar da iska ta hanyar taɓa haƙoran sama da gaban harshe.
subtopic: Gabobin Magana Da Muhimmancin Su

question: Me zai faru idan aka sami matsala ko nakasa a gabobin magana?
explanation: Nakasa a gabobin magana tana hana mutum furta sautuna da kalmomi a fili yadda ya kamata.
subtopic: Gabobin Magana Da Muhimmancin Su
